# konnect_identity_group_api_key (Resource)

IdentityGroupAPIKey Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_group_api_key" "my_identitygroupapikey" {
  provider = konnect-beta
  directory_id = "43362763-22ea-4f72-a11c-338abb6a15f8"
  expires_at   = "2022-11-04T20:10:06.927Z"
  group_id     = "6a68841d-e321-49ad-bef4-e849bcf5b944"
  managed_by = {
    key = "value"
  }
  metadata = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
  name     = "...my_name..."
  owner_id = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
  secret   = "...my_secret..."
  type     = "v1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) ID of the directory
- `group_id` (String) Unique identifier of the group (UUID format)
- `type` (String) possible known values include one of ["imported", "v1"]; Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity expiration date.
- `managed_by` (Map of String) Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long, start and end with an alphanumeric character, and may contain dashes (`-`), underscores (`_`), and dots (`.`).
Values must be 1–127 characters long and must not be empty.
Keys and values must not contain spaces or control characters.
- `metadata` (String) A map of metadata key-value pairs associated with this entity. This metadata is passed to the data plane to enrich the execution context. During authentication, metadata is inherited and overridden in a hierarchical manner: Directory metadata is inherited by Principals, which is then inherited and overridden by Credentials. Parsed as JSON.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the API key. `null` if the key has no name.
- `owner_id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.

Principal that owns a project key. Required when creating a key on a project group and rejected with `invalid_parameters` (400) when the holder group is not a project group. The owner must be a member of the project. Immutable.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Required if `type` is `imported`. Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_group_api_key.my_konnect_identity_group_api_key
  id = jsonencode({
    directory_id = "..."
    group_id     = "..."
    id           = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_group_api_key.my_konnect_identity_group_api_key '{"directory_id": "...", "group_id": "...", "id": "..."}'
```
